headline: Sensex and Nifty Decline as Selling Pressure in IT Stocks Triggers Market Correction

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy selling pressure in IT stocks dragged benchmark indices lower.
Profit booking emerged following a major market rally over recent weeks.
A surge in crude oil prices and weakness in the rupee impacted investor sentiment.
Investors opted to lock in gains despite ongoing foreign institutional investor inflows.
whatHappening: Sensex fell significantly during the session, slipping by hundreds of points to around 1,000 points at its session lows.
Nifty 50 broke below key support levels of 25,900 and 25,700.
IT sector led the market sell-off while metal and defence stocks showed relative resilience.
Blackstone sold a 1.55% stake in IGI worth Rs 280 crore to align with public shareholding regulations.
summary: Indian equities traded lower on 27 November 2026 as profit booking and heavy selling in IT stocks pulled benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty down sharply. Rising crude oil prices and rupee weakness added to market pressure, snapping the recent rally. While metals and defence stocks outperformed, the broader market closed in the red.
